text: Long ago, this world was perfectly harmonious.
Every creature was a living melody.
The Hoppits kept time like metronomes,
the Tallhorn held long notes as smooth as strings,
and even the Swamp Heralds’ low frequencies could shake a concert hall.
She sang so horribly off-pitch that the entire world went crooked!
In this moment of crisis, you were chosen to receive a legendary DJ deck.
With it, you can tune the world and blast off-key monsters back into harmony.
You’ll push forward,restore harmony to the land and find the Princess to tell her --
Please… you’re really out of tune.
